questions.topic: Marrow · 18.Measles, Mumps, Rubella and Other Viral Infections
questions.stemHtml: A mother brought her 7-year-old child to the OPD because of fever and facial swelling for the past 2 days. She says that he has been refusing to eat because of the pain near the jaw. He has not been vaccinated since birth because of his parent's fear of side effects. On examination, a tender swelling is noted on the jaw as shown in the picture. Which of the following statement is true regarding this patient's diagnosis?

options.label: B
options.text: Salivary gland involvement is limited to the parotids

options.label: C
options.text: Patient is not infectious prior to clinical parotid enlargement
